data.long_meaning: Marjuwwah is a name derived from the Arabic root 'r-j-w', which means 'to cultivate'. It signifies a nurturer, a gardener, or someone who takes care of and fosters growth. The name Marjuwwah can be a reminder of the importance of hard work, patience, and dedication to the land, as well as to personal growth and spiritual development.

It can be seen as a reminder of the importance of nurturing one's faith and character, just as a gardener nurtures and cultivates plants to help them grow. The name Marjuwwah is a powerful reminder of the importance of personal growth and self-improvement, and can serve as an inspiration for individuals to devote themselves to their spiritual journey and strive towards being the best version of themselves.
